items.exampleEn: The washing machine spins the clothes to make them dry faster.
items.exampleZh: 洗衣機轉動衣服，讓它們乾得比較快。

items.exampleEn: These apple trees yield a lot of fruit every autumn.
items.exampleZh: 這些蘋果樹每年秋天都結很多果實。

items.exampleEn: He wants to found a small music school one day.
items.exampleZh: 他希望有一天能創辦一所小型音樂學校。

items.exampleEn: The new camera can detect faces even in the dark.
items.exampleZh: 這台新相機即使在黑暗中也能偵測到人臉。

items.exampleEn: Two runners withdrew from the race because of the heat.
items.exampleZh: 兩名選手因為天氣太熱退出了比賽。

items.exampleEn: Rub the stain with a little soap and warm water.
items.exampleZh: 用一點肥皂和溫水搓洗那塊汙漬。

items.exampleEn: The city altered the bus routes after the new bridge opened.
items.exampleZh: 新橋通車後，市政府更改了公車路線。

items.exampleEn: Can you squeeze one more person into the car?
items.exampleZh: 車上還能再擠一個人嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Squeeze some lemon over the fish before you serve it.
items.sentenceZh: 上菜前在魚上擠一些檸檬汁。

items.audioEn: This shirt is too long, so I'm taking it to a shop to have it altered.
items.audioZh: 這件襯衫太長了，所以我要拿去店裡修改。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要把襯衫拿去店裡？

items.sentenceEn: The children laughed as the wheel spun faster and faster.
items.sentenceZh: 輪子越轉越快，孩子們都笑了。

items.sentenceEn: Dogs can detect smells that people cannot notice at all.
items.sentenceZh: 狗能察覺到人完全聞不到的氣味。

items.stemEn: The town was ____ by farmers more than three hundred years ago.
items.stemZh: 這個小鎮是三百多年前由農民建立的。

items.stemEn: She went to the bank to ____ some money for the trip.
items.stemZh: 她去銀行領一些錢準備旅行。

items.passageEn: My great-grandmother founded a small wool shop in our town in 1950. In the back room, she used to spin wool by hand on an old wooden wheel. Today my aunt runs the shop. Last winter, sales were falling, so she decided to alter the way the shop works. She started online classes that teach people how to knit, and the classes soon yielded more money than the shop itself. A small machine in the shop also detects when the air is too damp for the wool. My aunt still rubs her hands together before every class, a habit she learned from her grandmother.
items.passageZh: 我的曾祖母在 1950 年於鎮上開了一家小毛線店。在後面的房間裡，她以前會用一台舊木輪手工紡羊毛。現在這家店由我阿姨經營。去年冬天銷售量下滑，所以她決定改變店的經營方式。她開了教人編織的線上課程，這些課很快就賺得比店面本身還多。店裡還有一台小機器，能偵測空氣對毛線來說是不是太潮濕。阿姨每次上課前仍會搓搓雙手，這是她從奶奶那裡學來的習慣。

questions.questionZh: 什麼賺的錢比店面本身還多？
阿姨每次上課前有什麼習慣？

items.promptZh: 她緊緊握了一下我的手，叫我別擔心。
referenceEn: She squeezed my hand and told me not to worry.
She gave my hand a squeeze and told me not to worry.
rubricZh: 「緊握」可寫，例如 squeezed my hand、gave my hand a squeeze 等
「叫我別擔心」可寫，例如 told me not to worry、said I shouldn't worry 等
時態合理（例如 squeezed、told 等）

items.promptZh: 他累的時候常常揉眼睛。
referenceEn: He often rubs his eyes when he is tired.
When he feels tired, he often rubs his eyes.
rubricZh: rub 指「揉」（例如 rubs his eyes 等）；主詞是 he，動詞配合主詞
often 位置不扣分；when 子句可放句首或句尾

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（rub）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id b2-u41-l01-q17；目標字沿用 rub
